_about: CM-041 evidence gate. For each page type: the facts its spec needs before a brief may be written. 'from' says where the fact lives: 'A:<field>' = Brand Guide Section A row, 'D:<fact>' = Brand Guide Section D row (matched by the start of the row label), 'page:<key>' = a page-specific fact the Build agent records in clients/<slug>/build/evidence/<page_id>.facts.json (value, status, source). Statuses use the Brand Guide vocabulary and map to the grid as: Client Confirmed / Paul Approved / Internally Verified WITH a source -> Known; Submitted, or any value with no status or no source -> Unverified; Disputed -> Conflict; empty or Unknown -> Unknown. Thresholds are Paul's starting values (rulings.md CM-041); he tunes them here.
_thresholds_about: A gap is Unknown, Unverified or Conflict. BLOCK: any required fact in Conflict; or 2+ required facts that are gaps; or fewer than 3 Known facts in total (CM-015 needs at least 3 verifiable facts, so the draft could not pass E2). PASS: no required gap, no Conflict anywhere, at most 2 supporting gaps, and at least 3 Known. Anything else is WARN: the brief is written and must carry an 'Evidence gaps' section listing every gap.

_find_about: CM-057 (Paul, 2026-10-09): research before asking. Before a fact can be a gap, scripts/sources.py searches every source on disk (reviews, the client's own site text, a GBP export, the local grid, rankings). 'find' lists the search terms per fact key: each entry is a regex, or a list of regexes that must all match one sentence. {service} and {city} are the page's own service variant and city. A fact with no entry is not searched (identity fields come from Brand Guide A). 'found_marks' sets what a hit counts as, per source kind: a review hit is Known only when review_min_independent (3) or more different reviewers say it and nothing conflicts (customer_reported: the page states it only as customers describe it, 'customers mention…'; prices, timelines and warranty terms only as a cited customer example); a hit on the client's own site or a GBP export is Unverified (old site claims are confirmed with one yes/no, never re-asked as an open question). Every hit is cited (file, row, date, quote).

verify_by_lookup.D:Licence numbers: the state licensing board's licensee lookup (methodology/sources/<state>-<area>.md → State · public lookups)
verify_by_lookup.D:Certifications: the manufacturer's own contractor finder (methodology/sources/README.md → Public lookups)
verify_by_lookup.D:Insurance: a public certificate only (a state or board listing); none found → a client fact (an Ask, kind 2)

_verify_by_lookup_about: CM-061 part 2 (rewrite 3 §4.1): client facts that have a public lookup are verified, not asked — the researcher looks them up first (research.py log). Only a lookup logged not_found at the minimum may then become an Ask (a legal or money claim, kind 2). Business registration (the state's business entity search) is looked up the same way when a page needs it.
_public_facts_about: Rewrite 2 P6 (Q5): facts about a place are public — the researcher agent looks them up in official sources (methodology/sources/<state>-<area>.md first) and cites them; they are never asked of the client. Every other fact is a client fact, asked only after the search order (facts.json, decisions-settled.md, reviews, site text, GBP, proof sheet and Discovery Record).
